headline: Abinader proposes direct flight between Dubai and the Dominican Republic
summary: President Luis Abinader proposed a direct Emirates flight between Dubai and the Dominican Republic. He said it would strengthen commercial, tourism and cultural ties with the United Arab Emirates, speaking at the opening of a Latin America government summit dialogue.
why: Direct air links reduce travel time and cost, which can boost tourism revenue, trade flows and investment between the two countries. Emirates is the Dubai-based flag carrier of Emirates Group, which is not separately listed.
original_headline: Abinader propone vuelo directo entre Dubái y República Dominicana
